lines.zh: 我沿着田埂走，脚不沾泥。
lines.en: I walk the field ridge, my feet taking no mud.

lines.zh: 我走过晒衣绳，衣服不晃。
lines.en: I pass the washing line and the clothes do not stir.
I walk toward that lamp.
Each step, I glance at you.

lines.zh: 我走得太自然了，反而奇怪。
lines.en: I walk so naturally it becomes strange.

lines.zh: 我绕过水井，往里看了一眼。
lines.en: I pass the well and look in.
I cast two shadows.
I stop at the door and raise a hand.
When I walk, my feet point the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，手掌贴着墙。
lines.en: I walk along the wall, palm on the stones.
I reach the crossroads and choose a side.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声比我的脚慢。
lines.en: My footsteps lag behind my feet.
I walk into the trees, and back out.

lines.zh: 我把路走熟了，就不走了。
lines.en: Once I know the road, I stop walking it.
I stand outside the fence, not moving.
Frost on the roof. Dawn is near.
I am listening to the voices inside.
I learn a phrase, then pause.

lines.zh: 我的嘴形和声音对不上。
lines.en: My lip movements do not match the sound.
My nails scrape the wooden rail.
When I smile, there is no sound.
I am counting the windows in the village.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在暗处不太清楚。
lines.en: My outline is unclear in the dark.

lines.zh: 我知道你从哪条路回来。
lines.en: I know which road you come back by.

lines.zh: 我抬手摸了摸自己的脸。
lines.en: I raise a hand and touch my own face.
My breathing is something I learned.

lines.zh: 我把脚挪了挪，换个姿势。
lines.en: I shift my feet to a new stance.
I am waiting for someone to open the door.

lines.zh: 我照着你昨天的样子站着。
lines.en: I stand the way you stood yesterday.

lines.zh: 我说话的时候，你别看我的嘴。
lines.en: Do not watch my mouth when I speak.
Did you close the window last night?
I have been outside the whole time.
I have learned your name.
How many people are in your house?
I have counted your windows.
You came back later than yesterday.
I will not come in. I will stay here.
Do not turn off your lamp.
Do I sound like you?

lines.zh: 你退到门里，我也看得见你。
lines.en: Even inside the door, I can see you.

lines.zh: 你打中我了，手感不对吧。
lines.en: You hit me. The impact felt wrong, did it not?
That made my outline waver.
I do not bleed, and I do not retreat.
My face went crooked. I straighten it.
The harder you strike, the more human I look.
I do not need to bind that wound.
I stand and wait for you to finish.
My voice catches once.
I do not fear pain. I have none.
Only fire can make me come apart.
I don't eat that. Only fire works.

lines.zh: 你把它端出来，是想让我走吗。
lines.en: Are you bringing it out to make me leave?
I have no insides.

lines.zh: 这盘东西，你留着自己吃。
lines.en: Keep that plate for yourself.
I only need you to open the door.

lines.zh: 你端着它的时候，门开着。
lines.en: The door was open while you carried it.
Do not let your hand shake. I am watching.
I do not want to eat. I want to come in.
Put the plate down and go back inside.
These are not food to me.
Whatever you give me, I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 你留一口给屋里的人吧。
lines.en: Leave a mouthful for whoever is inside.
I do not need it. Do not bother.
The politer you are, the less I trust it.

lines.zh: 你把门关上了，这盘东西白端。
lines.en: You shut the door. That plate was wasted.
You hit me like stepping into cold water.
I did not move; you did.
Do not test me with your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们贴得太近了，你听得见吗。
lines.en: We are too close. Can you hear it?

lines.zh: 这一撞，你手上有淤青了。
lines.en: That will leave a bruise on your arm.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的力气偏了一点。
lines.en: I lean a little with your push.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，我跟着挪。
lines.en: When you step back, I shift after you.

lines.zh: 你的肩穿过我的轮廓，我歪了一下。
lines.en: Your shoulder passes through my outline and I tilt.
You are still in front of me. Good.
I have only one shape.

lines.zh: 你问得像在跟邻居说话。
lines.en: You ask as if talking to a neighbour.
I have learned many things. Not this.
Has anyone in the village asked that?

lines.zh: 我不需要这个，我需要门。
lines.en: I do not need that. I need a door.
Do not say it standing behind me.
My kind do not ask.
Lower your voice.
I cannot remember such words.
Go back inside.
I pick up this piece of wood.
I hold it, learning how to grip.
It makes no sound in my hand.
I set it on the windowsill.
You dropped this. I know.

lines.zh: 我举高它，看看你的反应。
lines.en: I raise it to see how you react.
I bend it. It does not snap.
I use it to knock on the door.
No answer from inside.
I leave it at the door.
You turned around.
I see the side of your face.
I close half a step.
You have raised the lamp.

lines.zh: 光让我的轮廓清楚了一些。
lines.en: The light makes my outline clearer.
You are looking for my eyes.
I have always had eyes.
You retreat toward the door.
The door opens inward.
I follow you around the yard.
You run; I walk a little faster.
I need not breathe.
I count every step you take.
The fence is too low.
You have gone behind the well.
I wait on this side of the well.
The lamp doesn't reach where I stand.
You have stopped to listen.
I make no sound at all.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你手腕，冰得像门框。
lines.en: My fingers clamp your wrist, cold as a door frame.

lines.zh: 我的力气不像我的手那么细。
lines.en: My strength does not match my thin hands.
I push; you hit the door.
That knocked the lamp from your hand.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，只是不放手。
lines.en: I mean no harm. I simply do not let go.

lines.zh: 你挣开了，我的手还在原处。
lines.en: You tore free; my hand stays where it was.
I raise my hand faster than you expect.

lines.zh: 我的指甲在你皮肤上留下印。
lines.en: My nails leave a mark on your skin.
You shout. No one answers.

lines.zh: 我退开，让你以为结束了。
lines.en: I draw back so you think it is over.
I stand outside the fence at nightfall.

lines.zh: 我的脸上还留着别人的轮廓。
lines.en: My face still carries someone else's outline.
I raise my hands and look at them.

lines.zh: 这里有一户人家，亮着灯。
lines.en: There is a house here with a light on.
I walk toward the window.
I learn to straighten my back.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩进泥里，没有印。
lines.en: I step in mud and leave no print.
I remember which door to knock on.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，等了一会儿。
lines.en: I stand at the door and wait a while.
Someone is talking inside.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的边角开始卷。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my edges curl.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶掉下，身体却摆正了。
lines.en: I fall from the roof and the body rights itself.

lines.zh: 水漫过我，我站在水底看着。
lines.en: Water closes over me; I stand at the bottom and watch.

lines.zh: 爆炸炸开我，我慢慢聚回来。
lines.en: The blast scatters me; I gather slowly back.
The arrow passes through and the hole closes.

lines.zh: 咒力让我的脸变了一次。
lines.en: The curse changes my face once.

lines.zh: 刀砍不动我，只有火可以。
lines.en: Blades don't work; only fire does.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我的声音断了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my voice cuts out.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，脸还朝上看着。
lines.en: I fall, my face still turned upward.
